presentationTable.name: Collection

presentationColumns.name: Collection Name
presentationColumns.description: Business-facing collection name, such as an Autumn/Winter or Spring/Summer assortment.

presentationColumns.name: Collection Code
presentationColumns.description: Compact collection identifier combining season and year, such as SS26 or AW26. Use this for concise selectors, dashboard labels, and AI prompts when the full collection name is too verbose.

presentationColumns.name: Season Name
presentationColumns.description: Readable season name for the collection.

presentationColumns.name: Collection Year
presentationColumns.description: Year associated with the collection launch and selling lifecycle. Kept in the presentation layer because the Collection hierarchy needs a valid Year-level display column.

presentationColumns.name: Launch Date
presentationColumns.description: Planned launch date for the collection.

presentationColumns.name: Markdown Start Date
presentationColumns.description: Date when planned markdown activity begins for the collection.

presentationColumns.name: Clearance Start Date
presentationColumns.description: Date when clearance activity begins for the collection.

presentationColumns.name: End Date
presentationColumns.description: Planned end date for the collection lifecycle.

presentationColumns.name: Primary Weather
presentationColumns.description: Weather or climate context most relevant to the collection assortment.

presentationColumns.name: Story
presentationColumns.description: Merchandising narrative or buying theme associated with the collection.

presentationTable.description: Core merchandising collection dimension with launch, markdown, clearance, and seasonal context.
